messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: P1 - model-catalog -> config drift detected; runtime errors spike for prod model routes. Auto-page to on-call.

pagerduty: INCIDENT-4519 created and routed to on-call (maria). Summary: multiple 500s from inference gateway tied to recent catalog revision. Escalation policy: on-call -> runtime -> eng-sre.

maria (oncall): Acked. Looking. Any immediate customer reports?

lia (cs): We have 2 customer tickets (enterprise) reporting malformed tokenization and repeated 500s since ~10:05 UTC. They attached examples.

alex (runtime): I'm seeing a sudden rise in TokenizationError in the gateway logs after a config push to catalog revision r-2026-05-18-3. Errors all point to mismatched tokenizer_name between catalog entry and model artifact.

kevin (catalog): Who pushed that revision? I rolled a couple quick metadata changes earlier but didn't touch tokenizer settings. Pulling audit.

kevin (catalog): Audit shows automated pipeline bumped default_revision -> r-2026-05-18-3 as part of a sync. The model artifact for that rev expects 'bp-tokenizer-v2' but the catalog entry was set to 'bp-tokenizer-v1' due to a templating bug.

alex (runtime): That explains it. Runtime loads tokenizer based on catalog defaults; mismatch leads to tokenization exceptions and 500s. We need to prevent serving that rev.

maria (oncall): Immediate mitigation: take affected routes off the rollout. Can we set routing policy to force fallback to r-2026-05-17-9 (previous stable) for the problematic route ids?

alex (runtime): I can pin the route to the previous revision for all customers while we fix catalog. Command I will run: 
```
# pin route to stable rev
redwood route update --route-id prod/text-gen --model-revision r-2026-05-17-9 --force
```

sanjay (eng-sre): I'm prepping an infra-side safeguard: add a temporary admission block for any catalog revision that mismatches tokenizer checksum with model artifact. That'll stop further bad syncs.

kevin (catalog): Working on a rollback patch for the templating script. ETA ~10-15m. I will also add a validation step to the pipeline to compare tokenizer_name and checksums.

lia (cs): Notifying impacted customers that we're rolling back and do not expect data loss. I'll post a short update: "We're investigating tokenization errors affecting inference; routing will be rolled back to a stable revision. Will update in 15m."

pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by maria. Next escalation in 15m if not resolved.

alex (runtime): Pin command executed, confirmed traffic shifted to r-2026-05-17-9, error rates dropping in 30s. Sample log: 
```
[10:12:44] INFO route-update: prod/text-gen pinned to r-2026-05-17-9
[10:12:58] WARN gateway: tokenization errors decreasing; 200 responses rising
```

maria (oncall): Good. Can we block serving of r-2026-05-18-3 until catalog fixes land?

kevin (catalog): Yes, marking r-2026-05-18-3 as 'quarantined' in catalog and pushing validation change. Pushed patch to pipeline - will monitor.

sanjay (eng-sre): Added an admission rule in the control plane: reject catalog revisions where tokenizer_name != artifact.tokenizer_name. Applied to sync pipeline.

lia (cs): Customer update sent. They acknowledged and appreciate the quick rollback.

maria (oncall): Summary for incident doc: root cause = catalog sync updated default_revision to r-2026-05-18-3 but templating bug left tokenizer_name stale -> runtime loads wrong tokenizer -> TokenizationError -> 500s. Mitigation = pin routes to previous stable rev, quarantine bad revision, admission check added, pipeline validation patch.

alex (runtime): We'll run a small smoke test across affected tenants to confirm no latent issues. Doing that now.

alex (runtime): Smoke tests all green for key routes. Error rate stabilized to baseline.

kevin (catalog): I've merged the pipeline validation and a hotfix for templating. Deploying safer sync now.

sanjay (eng-sre): Monitoring systems show latency and error rate back to normal. I'll leave the admission rule for 24h and then open a change for permanent validation.

maria (oncall): I'll hand off to kevin for postmortem and to finalize follow-ups. kevin, take it?

kevin (catalog): Taking. Will own the postmortem, include CS notes, and track the follow-ups: pipeline validation, templating fixes, extra unit tests.

lia (cs): I'll close the customer tickets after confirming they see normal behavior.

maria (oncall): Closing the PD incident and adding timeline to incident tracker. If anyone sees a recurrence ping me. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: INCIDENT-4519 resolved by maria. Resolution code: mitigated - rollback/fallback.

incident-bot: Incident thread archived to incidents/2026-05-18/catalog-config-drift for postmortem drafting.

kevin (catalog): Postmortem draft started. Will add required RCA and action items.

lia (cs): Note for postmortem: include exact customer impact windows, ticket numbers, and suggested customer-facing language.

maria (oncall): Thanks team. Handing off oncall at 11:00 UTC to jasper.

alex (runtime): One quick follow-up: we should add a runtime guard that rejects model load when tokenizer checksum mismatch is detected to fail-fast at admission time. Filing a JIRA.

kevin (catalog): Added follow-up tasks to the incident ticket. Closing thread.
